lines.text: EXCERPTA EX CODICE 8 (LAUR. 28, 14).
lines.en: EXCERPTS FROM CODEX 8 (LAUR. 28, 14).

lines.text: Haec HEPHAESTIONIS frustula publici iuris feci quasi libamenta totius operis quod
lines.en: I have made these fragments of HEPHAESTION public property as if they were libations of the whole work which

lines.text: propediem edere in animo habeo. Quae excerpta, extremo, si vis, excepto, ita cum
lines.en: I have in mind to publish very soon. Which excerpts, with the last one excepted if you wish, so agree with

lines.text: capitibus, in calce unius cuiusque nostri signatis, libri I ex codicibus Parisinis ab
lines.en: the chapters, marked at the end of each of ours, of book I from the Parisian codices edited by

lines.text: Engelbrechtio editis, consentiunt, ut ea iterum comprobetur opinio, quam alias
lines.en: Engelbrecht, that that opinion is again confirmed, which I have elsewhere

lines.text: exposui (Studi ital. etc., VI, 7), recensionem codicum Parisinorum nullo modo uni-
lines.en: set forth (Studi ital. etc., VI, 7), that the recension of the Parisian codices is in no way the only

lines.text: cam genuinamque, sed potius epitomen esse doctrinae celeberrimi auctoris.
lines.en: and genuine one, but rather an epitome of the doctrine of the most celebrated author.

lines.text: F. 42v. κζʹ. Τίνες τῶν ιβʹ τόπων εἰσὶ βελτίους.
lines.en: F. 42v. 27. Which of the 12 places are better.

lines.text: [in mg. Ἐν οἷς τόποις χαίρουσιν οἱ εʹ ἀστέρες].
lines.en: [in mg. In which places the 5 stars rejoice].

lines.text: Ὁ μὲν Κρόνος ἐν Ὑδροχόῳ χαίρει, ὁ Ζεὺς δ’ ἐν Τοξότῃ, ὁ δὲ Ἄρης
lines.en: Saturn rejoices in Aquarius, Jupiter in Sagittarius, and Mars

lines.text: ἐν Σκορπίῳ, Ἀφροδίτη <δ’> ἐν Ταύρῳ, Ἑρμῆς δ’ ἐν Παρθένῳ.
lines.en: in Scorpio, Venus <and> in Taurus, and Mercury in Virgo.

lines.text: <κηʹ. Περὶ διαφορᾶς τόπων>.
lines.en: <28. Concerning the difference of places>.

lines.text: Δώδεκα δὲ τόπων ὄντων τῶν διατιθεμένων, κάλλιστος μὲν ὁ ὡροσκό-
lines.en: There being twelve places that are disposed, the best is the horosco-

lines.text: πος, δεύτερος δὲ ὁ τοῦ μεσουρανήματος, τρίτος ὁ μετ’ αὐτὸν τριγωνι-
lines.en: pus, and the second is that of the midheaven, the third is the one after it trine-

lines.text: κῶς σχηματιζόμενος τῷ ὡροσκόπῳ, τέταρτος ὁ προηγούμενος τοῦ
lines.en: ly configured to the horoscopus, the fourth is the one preceding the

lines.text: μεσουρανήματος ἑξαγωνικὴν πλευρὰν τοῦ ὡροσκόπου ἀπέχων, πέμπτος
lines.en: midheaven, being distant by a hexagonal side from the horoscopus, the fifth

lines.text: ὁ διαμετρῶν τῷ ὡροσκόπῳ, τουτέστι τὸ δῦνον, ἕκτος τὸ ὑπόγειον
lines.en: is the one diametrically opposite to the horoscopus, that is the setting, the sixth is the subterranean

lines.text: μεσουράνημα, ἕβδομος ὁ τῷ μεσουρανήματι ἑπόμενος, καὶ ὁ ὄγδοος ὁ
lines.en: midheaven, the seventh is the one following the midheaven, and the eighth is the one

lines.text: τοῦ μεσουρανήματος προηγούμενος· οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ ἔξοχα πάντων εἰσὶ
lines.en: preceding the midheaven; and the rest are outstandingly of all

lines.text: στυγερώτατοι.
lines.en: most hateful.

lines.text: κθʹ. Περὶ οἰκοδεσποτίας καὶ συνοικοδεσποτίας.
lines.en: 29. Concerning rulership and co-rulership.

lines.text: Οἰκοδεσπότης λέγεταί τις ἀστὴρ τῶν εʹ, ζῳδίου τινὸς <κύριος>, ὁ τὸ
lines.en: A ruler is called a certain star of the 5, <lord> of a certain zodiacal sign, the one

lines.text: ζῴδιον ἔχων οἶκον· ὁ δὲ συμμετέχων αὐτῷ τῆς οἰκοδεσποτίας κατὰ τὸ
lines.en: zodiacal sign having as a house; and the one sharing with it the rulership according to the

lines.text: ἔχειν ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ ζῳδίῳ ὕψωμα ἢ τρίγωνον λέγεται συνοικοδεσπότης.
lines.en: having in the same zodiacal sign an exaltation or a triangle is called a co-ruler.

summary.headline: Hephaestion: Astrological Places and Rulership
summary.text: Excerpts from Codex 8 (Laur. 28, 14) of Hephaestion discuss planetary rejoicing places, the relative qualities of the twelve astrological places, and rulership and co-rulership of zodiacal signs. The introduction argues that the Parisian recension edited by Engelbrecht is an epitome rather than the sole genuine form of Hephaestion’s doctrine.
